scope: Supplemental factual review of nine Granite chains and SmolLM3. Ten additional chains permit use under recorded Apache conditions. This does not replace the earlier 30-chain review, grant rights, establish training-data/output rights, or approve the beta.
review_method: Anonymous public metadata and documentation only; no credentials, model weights, package installs or private repository access.

Refetched all source metadata and README files at frozen revisions and checked matching retained README fingerprints. Examined explicit model license declarations and declared ancestry separately from software licensing.

Read the complete canonical Apache 2.0 terms; pinned official IBM LICENSE copies have identical content after outer whitespace removal. Retain the original bytes and hashes, not an invented copyright attribution.
Resolved three Granite base names using fixed official IBM project READMEs and public base cards. Record consulted documentation revisions; do not claim exact training-input commits.
Check repository metadata for named license/NOTICE/COPYING/terms files. Preserve README attribution/declaration fingerprints even when there is no separate NOTICE file.
Keep missing grants, unresolved ancestry and conflicting commercial-use statements pending. License tags alone never suffice for promotion.
Website HTML stays in output/cache only. Proposed distributable licenses are plain text; a short pricing conflict excerpt is evidence only, not a license.
observation_boundary: Three newly resolved Granite ancestor documentation revisions are identified in additional_observations. They were not present in the initial source audit and are not asserted to be training-input commits. Original artifact and source-audit bytes remain unchanged.

No separate account/click-through acceptance requirement was observed.
